title: Bound pre-send observation-policy read failures before terminal LocalFailure
outcome: Transient or incoherent pre-send observation-policy reads use the existing bounded delivery-attempt owner rather than prematurely retiring the immutable report; definitive store mismatch stays fail-closed.
acceptance: A controlled pre-send Protocol failure followed by coherent policy retains the exact request/key and uses bounded retry; eventual exhaustion is visible and retains custody.
Definitive store mismatch does not send, and settled/unresolved removal fences remain intact.
The maintained full gate passes on the exact repaired input.
